name: Harness
description: One command installs a tested Claude Code harness: skills, hooks, rules, sub-agents and memory.

skills.name: install-harness
skills.description: Install the harness into a project without prompts, pick the tier, and confirm it works.

skills.name: debug-harness-hooks
skills.description: Find why a harness hook does not fire, fails, or blocks the wrong thing, and fix it.

skills.name: upgrade-harness
skills.description: Bring a project's installed harness up to the latest claude-harness without losing local edits.
